comment.narrative: NB Accumulated results for 2020 and 2021. In 2020 4 proposals social benefits and pensions tripartite agreement to protecting jobs and income agreement with JAAF to establish health commitees at enterprise level proposal to NLAC to amend wage board ordinance to have union dues check off become an authorised deduction. Participation in 3 international campaigns for workers rights pay your workers stop union busting and for the ratification of ILO convention 190In 2021 FTZGSEU prepared and presented 6 policy proposals on Extension og retirement age jointly with other TUs was achievedStronger Covid19 restrictions lockdown and protection of workers in the industry.Condemnation of suppression of Freedom of Association and Assembly Call to release detained protesters.Establishment of a GSP monitoring committeeCall for the government of Sri Lanka to ensure compliance with the prerequisites of the EU GSP regime.Petition against the proposed Colombo port city commission bill.
